```diff
- 
+ # EmailTemplateDynamicImportFix – Pseudocode
+ 
+ ## Objective
+ 
+ Eliminate runtime `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` errors when loading email templates in `/email-preview/[template]` by replacing runtime dynamic `import()` of TypeScript files with a static, build-time mapping of compiled modules.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## High-Level Plan
+ 
+ 1. **Identify Failure Cause**  
+    • `getEmailTemplate(slug)` attempted to `import()` `emails/templates/${slug}.tsx` during runtime.  
+    • Node cannot execute raw TypeScript – resulting in `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.
+ 2. **Solution Strategy**  
+    • Import every template **statically** so Next.js compiles them during build.  
+    • Register each imported module in a lookup table keyed by *slug* (filename without extension).  
+    • `getEmailTemplate(slug)` now simply returns `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY[slug]`.
+ 3. **Implementation Steps**  
+ 
+    ```text
+    a. In src/lib/email-templates.ts
+       i.  Define helper `resolveTemplate(mod)` -> picks default export or first named export.
+       ii. Namespace-import every template file (e.g. `import * as NewsletterModule from '../../emails/templates/newsletter-email-template'`).
+       iii. Build `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` using `resolveTemplate()` for each module.
+       iv. Update `getEmailTemplate` to read from registry first, falling back to old fs/dynamic logic for edge cases.
+    b. No changes required to template files themselves.
+    c. Maintain existing `getEmailTemplates()` directory scan for metadata.
+    ```
+ 
+ 4. **Risk / Edge Cases**  
+    • New templates must be added to the registry – documented in comments.  
+    • If a module exports multiple values, `resolveTemplate` picks the first; adjust if needed.
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## Expected Outcome
+ 
+ • `/email-preview/[template]` now renders all templates without runtime errors.  
+ • API routes importing templates (e.g. wholesalers) remain unaffected.  
+ • Build remains incremental; static imports are tree-shaken by Next.js.
+ 
```

+ # EmailTemplateDynamicImportFix – Implementation Notes
+ 
+ ## Modified Files
+ 
+ 1. **`src/lib/email-templates.ts`**  
+    • Added static namespace-imports for every template in `emails/templates`.  
+    • Implemented `resolveTemplate` helper to gracefully extract the component (default or first named export).  
+    • Created `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` mapping `slug -> component`.  
+    • Updated `getEmailTemplate(slug)` to look up in the registry first, falling back to legacy dynamic logic for yet-to-be-registered templates.
+ 2. **`EmailTemplateDynamicImportFix_PSEUDOCODE.md`**  
+    • Captures the step-by-step reasoning and high-level plan.
+ 
+ ## Data Flow After Fix
+ 
+ ```
+ [email-preview route] ─┐
+                       ▼
+            getEmailTemplate(slug)
+                       ▼ (registry lookup)
+             TEMPLATE_REGISTRY[slug]
+                       ▼
+                React.createElement()
+                       ▼
+                  @react-email/render
+                       ▼
+                  HTML preview page
+ ```
+ 
+ * All template components are now part of the build graph, ensuring type-safety and eliminating runtime `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` errors.
+ 
+ ## Key Considerations
+ 
+ • **Extensibility** – New templates require a single namespace import and registry entry.  
+ • **Performance** – Static imports allow Next.js to tree-shake unused templates in production bundles.  
+ • **Backward Compatibility** – The fallback dynamic import preserves previous behaviour for unregistered files.
+ 
```

Scope clarified:
• Root cause – runtime `import()` of TypeScript files in `getEmailTemplate` fails, producing MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors in the preview route.

Key changes (minimal, contained):
1. `src/lib/email-templates.ts`
   • Added static namespace-imports for every file in `emails/templates`.
   • Introduced `resolveTemplate` helper to pick default or first named export.
   • Built `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` mapping slug ⇒ component.
   • Updated `getEmailTemplate` to return from the registry first, falling back to the old logic for any future, un-registered templates.

2. Documentation
   • Created `EmailTemplateDynamicImportFix_PSEUDOCODE.md` (step-by-step plan).
   • Created `EmailTemplateDynamicImportFix.md` (implementation summary, data-flow).

No other files touched.  
This removes the runtime module-not-found errors and lets `/email-preview/[template]` render all templates successfully.
